name: apexbot
description: ApexBot — AI moderation and FTC intelligence for Discord

scripts.build: npm run build -w @apexbot/shared && npm run build -w @apexbot/bot && npm run build -w @apexbot/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @apexbot/shared && npm run typecheck -w @apexbot/bot && npm run typecheck -w @apexbot/dashboard
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
